name: Nihongo Master v1.1.5
changelog: v1.1.5: Fixed cut-off and missing borders across all UI boxes on Title Screen and Stage Select. Implemented smooth bilinear area-averaging downscaling to eliminate downscale column subsampling on 1280x800 handheld displays, and reinforced all card, pill, and button outlines with high-contrast minimum 2px/3px borders.
